coordinates.description:
List of coordinates for nonzero entries in the tensor, where each coordinate is represented by a list of
[x, y, z, ...] coordinates in COO.  Alternatively, if you think of this as a 2d array, the first (outer) dimension
is a point, while the second (inner) dimension has the coordinates for that point.

title:
Do not use this Type directly.  It is meant to define the internal data representation in {@link SparseTensor}.
Use {@link SparseTensor} instead.

This is data for the Coordinate List (COO) sparse matrix representation.  Note that the dimensions of the matrix
are not stored here (See [](SparseTensor#shape)).

Each coordinate is paired with a value, to represent an entry in the tensor.  Similar to the COO sparse matrix format
in Python Numpy, we may have duplicate coordinates (the value of the entry should be the sum of all the values with
the same coordinates), there may be coordinates for zero valued entries (this is not a compact representation, but
still valid), and the coordinates do not need to be sorted.
name: CooSparseTensorData
